_doc: Fieldbook 'Males and females' lines: one true sentence or two per species whose sexes look different (ui/pedia_screen.gd add_sexes, core/sexes.gd). Each id also has a "dimorph" key in its art/recipes/creatures recipe, which tools/spritegen.gd renders as <id>_f / <id>_m sheets.

notes.caperling: The cock is a huge dark bird with a green breast and a red wattle over the eye. The hen is about half his weight, mottled brown with an orange breast, and well hidden on the nest.
notes.capercaillie: The cock is a huge dark bird with a green breast and a red wattle over the eye. The hen is about half his weight, mottled brown with an orange breast, and well hidden on the nest.
notes.lekling: The cock is a huge dark bird with a green breast and a red wattle over the eye. The hen is about half his weight, mottled brown with an orange breast, and well hidden on the nest.
notes.lekbruiser: The cock is a huge dark bird with a green breast and a red wattle over the eye. The hen is about half his weight, mottled brown with an orange breast, and well hidden on the nest.
notes.ptarmlet: In spring the cock has a red comb above each eye, bigger and brighter than the hen's.
notes.ptarmigan: In spring the cock has a red comb above each eye, bigger and brighter than the hen's.
notes.buntling: In summer the male is crisp white with a black back. The female is greyer on the head and streaked brown on the back.
notes.snowbunting: In summer the male is crisp white with a black back. The female is greyer on the head and streaked brown on the back.
notes.ospret: A female usually has a darker, more speckled necklace across her chest than the male.
notes.lochosprey: A female usually has a darker, more speckled necklace across her chest than the male.
notes.barnling: Males tend to be whiter underneath. Females are buffer and more heavily speckled.
notes.hushwing: Males tend to be whiter underneath. Females are buffer and more heavily speckled.
notes.squawkster: Adult males have a black and pink ring round the neck. Females have only a faint dark collar, or none.
notes.oriolet: The male Montserrat oriole is black and bright yellow. The female is a quieter olive-green and yellow.
notes.stagmor: Only stags grow antlers, and they cast and regrow them every year. Hinds have none.
notes.glenmonarch: Only stags grow antlers, and they cast and regrow them every year. Hinds have none.
notes.sikawhistle: Only stags grow antlers. Hinds are smaller and have none.
notes.bullmoose: Only bulls grow antlers, which can span well over a metre and are shed every winter. Cows have none.
notes.barkdeer: Bucks have small antlers and long upper tusks. Does have no antlers and no tusks to speak of.
notes.tuskbark: Bucks have small antlers and long upper tusks. Does have no antlers and no tusks to speak of.
notes.herdwick: Herdwick rams are horned. The ewes are hornless.
notes.agrino: Rams carry great curling horns. Ewes have short ones, or none at all.
notes.greyhaul: Bulls are bigger and darker with a long 'Roman' nose. Cows are smaller, silvery and blotched, with a daintier face.
notes.beachmaster: Only bulls grow the big inflatable nose that gives the elephant seal its name. Cows have an ordinary snout and are much smaller.
notes.orcaird: A bull orca's dorsal fin can stand about as tall as a person, upright like a blade. A cow's is much shorter and curves back.
notes.stagbeet: Males have the great antler-like jaws. Females have small jaws but give the harder nip.
notes.stagmajor: Males have the great antler-like jaws. Females have small jaws but give the harder nip.
notes.midgie: Only female midges bite, because they need a blood meal to make eggs. The males have bushier, feathered antennae.
notes.duneskink: In spring the male sand lizard turns bright green along his flanks. The female stays brown.
notes.zigzlet: The male adder is silvery-grey with a black zigzag. The female is brown with a darker brown zigzag.
notes.adderking: The male adder is silvery-grey with a black zigzag. The female is brown with a darker brown zigzag.
notes.natterjack: Only the males call, using a big vocal sac under the chin.
notes.natterchoir: Only the males call, using a big vocal sac under the chin.
notes.bradan: In autumn the male salmon grows a hooked lower jaw, the kype, and turns coppery. The hen fish stays plainer.
notes.glimmerjaw: In deep-sea anglerfish only the female has the glowing lure. The male is a fraction of her size.
notes.abyssjaw: In deep-sea anglerfish only the female has the glowing lure. The male is a fraction of her size.
notes.churrjar: Only the male has white patches on his wing tips and tail corners.
notes.nightchurr: Only the male has white patches on his wing tips and tail corners.
notes.starlet: In spring a male starling's bill has a blue-grey base. A female's is pinkish.
notes.murmurant: In spring a male starling's bill has a blue-grey base. A female's is pinkish.
notes.pepperling: Male moths have bushy, feathered antennae to catch a female's scent from far off. Females' are thin.
notes.sootwing: Male moths have bushy, feathered antennae to catch a female's scent from far off. Females' are thin.
